summary.text: Thomas Huff is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 49 since 2019 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Huff was born in Shepherdsville, Kentucky, where he lived as of February 2020.
His career experience includes working with Huff's Used Cars & Auto Parts LLC, and he has been a member of the Kosair Shrine Club and the Scottish Rite.

In the 2025-2026 session Huff was vice chair of the Economic Development & Workforce Investment Committee and chair of the House Enrollment Committee, and he also served on the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, State Government, and Transportation committees.
